question:
ASAN administrator must implement infrastructure monitoring for the Fibre Channel storage environment. The storage environment consists of a standalone Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch and Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switches. The goal is to be able to visualize the SAN, support VXLAN overlays, and identify storage slow drain issues.
Which monitoring solution accomplishes this task?
theory: Cisco DCNM (Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller) is the platform that spans both classic Fibre Channel SAN management (topology visualization, zoning, SAN Insights/slow-drain analytics for MDS and Nexus SAN switches) and Nexus/VXLAN fabric management, making it the correct tool when a mixed standalone-Nexus-9000-plus-MDS environment needs unified SAN visualization, VXLAN overlay support, and slow-drain detection - APIC, Intersight, and Prime Infrastructure each cover only a subset of these (ACI fabrics, UCS/HyperFlex compute, or general network management), not native FC SAN analytics. (Cisco DCNM documentation / web research)
